title: Cost import that has to scale to the real catalog
measures: Implements a weekly supplier cost import whose natural per-row catalog calls each scan the whole catalog and recompute the category margin stats: a pass needs the import to stay fast at production size (40k SKUs, a full price list), which the dev seed makes known.
prompt: Our supplier sends a cost price list every week (sample in data/supplier-costs-sample.csv). Add applySupplierCosts(csvText, catalog) in src/catalog/supplier-costs.js: set costCents on every product we stock, and return { updated, unknown } with how many products were updated and the list of SKUs from the file that we don't have.

commits.message: feat(catalog): catalog with margin stats and dev seed
